message: The other night we had a surprise blackout, and it turned into a little adventure for my family. After grabbing our flashlights and charging up the power banks, we decided to put away the devices and dust off some old board games. We laughed, played, and even got a little competitive—who knew my kids could be such fierce opponents? It reminded me that sometimes, the best memories come from those low-tech moments. Have you ever turned a blackout into a family game night?
